concepts.label: Flex Index feature (SQL++ query over a full-text index)
concepts.note: a feature/capability page, not itself a single SQL++ statement

relations.subject: n1ql:flex-indexes
relations.evidence: Starting with Couchbase Server 6.6, the _Flex Index_ feature provides the ability for a SQL++ query to leverage either a global secondary index or full-text index transparently with standard SQL++ syntax, simplifying the application development process.

relations.subject: n1ql:flex-indexes
relations.evidence: Full-text indexes are online and searchable as soon as they are created. GSI indexes are online and searchable after they have been built.

relations.subject: n1ql:flex-indexes
relations.note: structural link from an existing Markdown xref to covering-indexes.md
relations.evidence: A Flex Index query cannot use a full-text index as a [covering index](covering-indexes.md).
